method: built-in image_gen.imagegen, one sprite per call
fidelityLimit: Project reference identity; generated hidden geometry and panel details require review; requested camera degrees are intentions, not measurements.

views.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE transparent cinematic game sprite of the EXACT SAME Fugitive spacecraft from the supplied two master project references. First is the existing oblique profile; second is its top view. These are the same rigid ship. LOCK identity: broad rounded-diamond metallic main shell, black smooth hemispherical dorsal dome surrounded by concentric curved silver/gunmetal ribs and small red pin lights; substantial rounded dark underside; EXACTLY TWO spherical/egg-shaped rear engine nacelles attached on the LEFT by thick curved tubular arms, blue inset ports and short existing cyan-blue exhausts. The leading rounded point of the diamond is the nose and stays on the RIGHT; aft and both engines stay LEFT. Same scratched weathered gunmetal/silver material, subtle existing red lights, original proportions and parts, no extra nacelle, no orange engines, no antennae, new weapons, landing legs or new apertures. Keep the small original blue engine exhausts attached to their existing nozzle mouths, do not lengthen into large jets. Neutral soft upper-left lighting matching reference. Full entire ship centered on a1536x1024landscape canvas, complete tips and engine flames, clear transparent margin. True RGBA transparency outside ship, including open gaps between curved arms; no environment, ground, shadow plane, halo mist, checkerboard, text, labels or watermark. This must be a true change of the camera around a rigid object, not a rotated or skewed existing bitmap. Keep projected long axis roughly horizontal and upright, do not mirror.
CAMERA: shallow FRONT quarter. From the supplied profile camera, yaw12 degrees toward the RIGHT nose. Reveal slightly more of the leading front rim with the far side receding; preserve similar slight elevation and longitudinal proportions. Do not turn into a top view.
